3293-4693-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4693-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4693-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2645-2930-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

891-2034-8207.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5319-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
4247-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4053-4336-6495-6989.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
4053-4336-6495-6989.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4659-5220-7806.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4659-5220-7806.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3330-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1982-2523-2869.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying its mana cost.
When Sidisi enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Sidisi dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, allowing you to tutor a card to your hand.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a token copy of Sidisi that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Sidisi token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

3259-5434--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2921-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
2921-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1824-2530-6747-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6747-7351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1824-2530-6747-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

628-5226-7189.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

1090-4590-6884.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
1090-4590-6884.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Aang
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2919-3490-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-6719.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-5705-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2981-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
2981-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1-2498-4067-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2498-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-4050-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-4050-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

4779-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
4779-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 2.
4779-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1274-3490-4659-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-5870.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

413-719-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
413-719-5853.notablePrerequisites:
Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
You control no more than one Snail.
413-719-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Snail, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick and Blasting Station trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

2104-2788-3634-4568.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2104-2788-3634-4568.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1339-1636-4255.notablePrerequisites:
Enclave Cryptologist does not have summoning sickness.
Enclave Cryptologist has at least one level counter on it.
1339-1636-4255.description:
Activate Enclave Cryptologist by tapping it, causing you to either loot or draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

751-4306-5068.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least four.
751-4306-5068.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Lapis Lazuli Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Nyx Lotus.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-3213.description:
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
When Boromir dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Boromir that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Boromir ability from step 1, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Boromir token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Repeat.

57-914-2178-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
57-914-2178-4659.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

396-2232-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2872-4222-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Clever Conjurer.
Utopia Sprowl attached to a basic Forest you control.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
2872-4222-5227.description:
Activate the Forest with Utopia Sprowl attached, adding at least {G}.
Utopia Sprowl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

444-1722-1874-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-1722-1874-2034.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Drogskol Reaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

234-643-751.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
234-643-751.description:
Activate any permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Merrow Reejerey triggers, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

430-1061-1351.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the City's Blessing.
430-1061-1351.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nut Collector triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1636-2487.notablePrerequisites: Flamewright does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2487.description:
Pay {1} and tap Flamewright to create a 1/1 Construct.
The Construct enters untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2055-3518.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat any number of times, adding mana of any color in step 1 once you have an arbitrary amount of white mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Auriok Salvagers once for each valid target.

45-1518-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
45-1518-1987-4125.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells until end of turn.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
